say:1:1831002001:1.text: I'm waiting for someone. We agreed to meet here under the <style="highlight">full moon</style>, but she never came.
say:1:1831002001:1.male: I'm waiting for someone. We agreed to meet here under the <style="highlight">full moon</style>, but she never came.
say:1:1831002001:1.female: I'm waiting for someone. We agreed to meet here under the <style="highlight">full moon</style>, but she never came.

say:2:1831002002:1.text: How long have I waited? I only wake during a full moon, and each time, I wait here all night... Maybe she's forgotten me.
say:2:1831002002:1.source_cn: 我等了多久？每次满月我才醒，醒一次等一夜……她大概把我忘了。
say:2:1831002002:1.male: How long have I waited? I only wake during a full moon, and each time, I wait here all night... Maybe she's forgotten me.
say:2:1831002002:1.female: How long have I waited? I only wake during a full moon, and each time, I wait here all night... Maybe she's forgotten me.

say:3:1831002003:1.text: If you happen to meet her, please tell her I'm still waiting.
say:3:1831002003:1.source_cn: 如果你能遇见她的话，请替我告诉她一声，我还在等她。
say:3:1831002003:1.male: If you happen to meet her, please tell her I'm still waiting.
say:3:1831002003:1.female: If you happen to meet her, please tell her I'm still waiting.
